issues: Accessibility: Several screens (dashboard) contain nested interactive controls (buttons inside other pressable elements). The Axe static check reports 'nested-interactive' errors for elements with data-testid="fab-container". This violates accessibility guidelines and causes the static validation to fail. Refactor the UI so that interactive controls (e.g., the FAB and any buttons inside cards or list items) are not placed inside other pressable elements. Ensure each button or touchable has its own independent pressable container and no button is nested within another button or pressable component.

Unclear source: The exact file and line where the nested interactive controls are created is not directly visible in the provided source. Review components like FABAdd, ReceiptCard, MileageCard, SummaryCard, and any other pressable wrappers that may contain a button (or FAB) inside a Card or Pressable. Ensure that the outer container does not also handle press events (e.g., remove onPress from Card if it contains a Button), or split the inner button into a separate sibling element.
feedback: All acceptance tests passed, but the static validation failed due to serious accessibility violations (nested interactive elements). Fix the UI to eliminate nested pressables, then re-run validation.
